items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: we had the complete Jimmie Lunceford Band and the complete Count Basie Band and my band

ctx.x: 1939. We had three of these huge trucks with the trailers on them. We put pianos on each one and we had the complete Jimmie Lunceford Band and the complete Count Basie Band and my band, which my rhythm section was the King Cole Trio, with an added bass who was Red Callender. So I used two basses on it.
